summary: Iteration 9: guided kits from trusted sources (NCI/ACS/MedlinePlus). Backend 12/12 pytest passed: GET /api/guided-kits returns 13 g-<need> kits with guide{label,tips,precaution,sources(https cancer.gov/cancer.org/medlineplus.gov),reviewed}; free users get no for_you; Plus user with Cirugía treatment gets for_you on related kits (g-recovery tagged, g-cold not), tagged kits sorted first, declared need ('sleep') shows 'Elegiste este tema' and sorts first; GET /api/kits/g-sleep returns template+guide; unknown g-* -> 404; POST /api/cart kit g-memory adds correct name/price ($299) and /api/checkout/quote totals it; t1 template, /kits/suggested and /recommendations regression OK. Frontend (390x844) all flows pass: Mis kits 'Según guías confiables' (kits-guides) shows 4 compact guide cards (Plus: g-sleep first with badge), 'Ver todas' -> /guides (guides-screen, 13 cards; free note shown only for free demo user), guide-toggle-g-memory expands/collapses tips + precaution + source link (opens cancer.gov in new tab), guide-open-g-memory -> /kit/g-memory with kit-guide-info, Personalizar -> /kit-builder?template=g-memory prefilled '4 de 4 artículos · completo $299', Al carrito from /kit/g-sleep -> /cart shows 'Noches más tranquilas $339'. No page errors. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Pre-existing: accepts non-existent kit/product ref_id (e.g. 'g-bogus') with 200 and stores an orphan cart doc that cart_view silently skips. Validate ref_id via find_template/db.kits/db.products and return 404.

for_you uses the caller's own treatments/declared needs; a caregiver never sees kits tied to the linked patient's treatments. Product decision — consider using linked patient's treatments for caregivers on Plus.

design_issues.screen: Mis kits - Según guías confiables (compact GuideCard)
issues: 4 thumbnails of 52px + gaps (226px) exceed 208px inner width of the 240px card, so images wrap to 2 rows and cards get tall (~331px). Use 44px thumbs or flexWrap: 'nowrap' with slice(0,3)+'+N'.
Long badge 'Relacionado con tu tratamiento registrado' wraps to 2 lines in compact card; consider shorter label e.g. 'Por tu tratamiento'.
Review date shown raw as '(2026-06)'; format in Spanish e.g. 'junio de 2026'.
Source link Pressable minHeight 32 (hitSlop 6 brings it ~44) — acceptable but borderline.

action_items: Optional: validate ref_id in POST /api/cart (404 for unknown kit/product).
Optional: compact guide card thumbnails wrap to 2 rows on Mis kits; reduce thumb size or count.
Optional: format guide 'reviewed' date in Spanish.
Content review: g-nausea and g-sleep kits include 'Vela de soya sin aroma' (open flame) for people who may be drowsy/fatigued — consider a safety note or swapping for a non-flame light.
critical_code_review_comments: knowledge.py guided_kits computes kit_view for all 13 kits on every request (multiple product lookups each); fine at this size but could cache product lookups.
REVIEWED='2026-06' is hardcoded constant applied to all guides; per-guide review dates would be more accurate.
server.py is 1350 lines (>700) — pre-existing, consider splitting.
